verdict.rationale: Stark Bank ships its own RESTful JSON API with a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec, SDKs in many languages, and an LLM-readable llms.txt and markdown docs, so an agent can use a clean programmatic surface instead of scraping a dashboard. However, the evidence never documents read endpoints for account balances, transaction history, pending activity, or statements and documents, and no MCP server is shown. missing for 10: documented balance/transaction/statement read endpoints, pending-activity visibility, document retrieval, an MCP server, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can read the full banking picture — accounts, transactions, pending activity, documents — through a clean API or MCP surface without screen-scraping a dashboard

citations.quote: Our API is RESTFul. This means we use predictable, resource-oriented URLs to do banking operations. The API itself speaks exclusively in JSON, including errors
You can download our yaml file right here. You can also try our Postman collection.
Developer documentation for the Stark Bank API
